itemized.escalation_note: p5-p8 are LANDSCAPE attachments: re-rendered at 300 dpi, rotated +90 and read as two column-blocks each (date+name | amount+occupation+employer) at ~270 dpi effective - about 1.8x the 150 dpi full-page first read. Row alignment between the two blocks is positional (identical y-coordinates) and was cross-checked on semantic anchors: the three 'Bradley'/'Nakamura' rows carry the LOAN marker, IBEW/AFSCME/PPAC rows carry Labor Union / Labor Organization / Political Action Committee, and 'Raffle Tix Cash' carries the only occupation-less $108
itemized.notes: 9-page 2012 interim. p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed), p3/p4 the Schedule A/B forms carrying only 'Please See Attached', p5-p8 the contributions attachment (188 rows, landscape), p9 the expenditures attachment (35 rows, portrait). ADDRESSES ARE COUNTY-REDACTED: the whole 'Complete Mailing Address' column on p5-p8 is a solid black block, so donor_city/donor_state are blank and every row note says redacted. NAME LAYOUT: the attachment prints the surname and the given name in two adjacent columns (surname first, under no header; 'Name' heads the given-name column). donor_raw joins them as 'Surname, Given'; rows that are organisations have an empty given-name cell and are recorded as the entity name alone. Four entity names are CLIPPED by their column edge and are noted per row. FOUR ROWS CARRY A 'LOAN' MARKER printed to the left of the amount (Jim Bradley $14,000 and $1,450, Glenda Bradley $5,000, Kerri Nakamura $800); they are contributions on this form and are inside the printed total. Two rows are unnamed cash ('Cash' $10, 'Cash' $30) and one is 'Raffle Tix Cash' $108 - kept as printed. Amounts on both attachments are printed WITHOUT CENTS on the contributions side (whole dollars) and with cents on the expenditures side; both are kept verbatim.
